hints.text: A seaside town famed for film shots and a giant monolith rising from the surf.
You'll see tufted puffin nesting signs in spring and summer around tidepools.
Face the 235-foot sea stack, your spot is where the basalt meets low-tide starfish.
A cliff-top beacon between Florence and Yachats that guards a sweeping cove.
Climb toward the keeper’s house; gulls circle and the beam sweeps the trees.
Stand by the white tower railing—listen for the horn and watch the Fresnel lens.
A dramatic sinkhole on black lava rock that inhales and explodes with the tide.
Follow the Spouting Horn signs; salty spray mists the viewpoint.
Stand at the fenced overlook where waves surge into the rock bowl and spray shoots upward.
